description.en: A five-page native DSH workbench to discover tools, Skills, plugin indexes and GitHub projects, select members, and install reviewed capability bundles. Connect the separately installable open-source Legion core for reference-driven research, collaboration, source-informed revisions, continuation and formal artifact downloads. Includes connection settings, separate run/export status, fixed Git releases and a DSH Discover index. Models and external harnesses are configured on demand.
description.zh: DSH 原生五页军团工作台：发现工具、Skill、插件索引和 GitHub 项目，选择成员并安装已审查的能力包。连接可独立安装的开源军团核心，开展对标研究、协作、源码互学返工、续作和正式成果下载；提供连接配置、运行与导出分别呈现、固定 Git 版本及 DSH Discover 索引。模型和外部 Harness 按需配置，不会自动全部安装。
